searchText: Definitely not as noisy as it was with London. Glacier forks are generally not the ones that attract a lot of attention 😅 I think that doing an (@)everyone announcement here would be a pretty good idea Nowadays almost everyone is using discord 🙂 https://forkmon.ethdevops.io seems to be down? (edit: it's back now) Published in <#595701770034872362> so people subscribing to this server can see. It’s useless without @everyone It's a discord announcements channel, other servers can wire it in to their own channels. I am not a fan of at everyone.
